VERDICT: Safe profitability gains exist only via instrumentation: fix silent tree-bypass with reason-coded counters, log candidate secondary features alongside settle_hour, and add a log-only hierarchical shrinkage diagnostic—no gate logic changes.

REASONING: With 92/94 cells in LEARNING and all 14 splits on a single axis (settle_hour), the tree is effectively one-dimensional, so any ARMED-rate improvement must come from better axis diversity and from eliminating flat-fallbacks that starve tree cells of samples. Both are diagnosable with counters/logging only. Hierarchical shrinkage (cell → parent node → flat prior) is sample-efficient but must stay log-only until its estimates are validated against realized outcomes.

NEXT_STEPS:
1. In adaptive_tree.build_axis_values(), add candidate secondary features (e.g., day_of_week, hours_to_settle bucket, market_category, spread bucket, price bucket) and emit a per-split-gain log in the split-selection routine so feature value can be ranked without changing splits.
2. Audit every call site of gate_decision (learning.py and any dispatch path): wrap the axis_values lookup so a missing key logs GATE_TREE_BYPASS with a reason code (MISSING_KEY, BUILD_FAIL, SCHEMA_MISMATCH, EMPTY_TREE); add counters keyed by reason in learning.py's metrics module.
3. Add a startup/invariant assertion helper assert_axis_values_from_tree() invoked once per cycle that verifies axis_values provenance equals build_axis_values() output; log violations, never raise in production path.
4. Implement hierarchical_shrinkage_diagnostic() in learning.py: for each cell compute shrunk estimate = weighted blend of cell mean, parent-node mean, flat mean with weights = n/(n+k); log shrunk vs raw delta per cell to a diagnostics file; do not feed into gate.
5. Add per-node feature-coverage logging in adaptive_tree (split feature histogram per tree build) to confirm settle_hour monopoly and track it over time.
6. Counter: TREE_CELL_ASSIGNED vs FLAT_FALLBACK per gate_decision, exported alongside existing ARMED/PROBATION/LEARNING counts.

CALL_BACK_IF: Any GATE_TREE_BYPASS counter exceeds ~1% of decisions, the shrinkage diagnostic shows stable out-of-sample improvement over raw cell estimates, or a secondary feature's logged split gain rivals settle_hour's.
